Abe (AE): Heads-up — OpalCore CISO paused the pilot. Blocking asks: (1) BYO-KMS attestation, (2) named demo SLA for latency, (3) clear swap plan to Private after pilot. Need exec alignment today. @Marisol @Connor :exclamation:
Marisol (Solutions): Quick read: We can run a fast demo on Dedicated w/ temporary managed KMS + IP allowlist and audit logs in 3 business days. BYO-KMS attestation path (full HSM handoff + paperwork) ~10 business days. Customer wants a firm start next Wed.
Connor (Eng-Infra): Connector + KMS plumbing notes: containerized connector + mutual-TLS + key wrap tests. ETA for engineering changes: 7-11bd. If OpalCore accepts temp managed-KMS with a guaranteed swap date, we can hit their start date.
Jamie (CS): CISO expects p95 < 450ms for short chat scenarios and a fallback to a smaller quantized model if we spike. Also asked for a 30-day cost delta between Dedicated vs Private.
Tess (Legal): I'll prep BYO-KMS contract language + an attestation addendum. Need sample evidence links for SOC2 and pen-test. Can someone drop links?
Marisol (Solutions): Dropping runbook link and quick test snippet — minimal validation for demo:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://pilot.opalcore.redwood/health
```
infra-bot: Note: network peering request created (#PR-4821). Ops owner assigned: Lina. Provide ASN/IPs to proceed.
Abe (AE): Action items: 1) Marisol one-pager (options + cost delta + SLA fallback) — due 11:30am PT, 2) Connor confirm connector ETA + list of infra changes — due 2pm PT, 3) Tess BYO-KMS draft EOD, 4) Jamie to request ASN/IPs & questionnaire from customer now.
Connor (Eng-Infra): I'll run a short feasibility spike and post a 5-line runbook snippet before 1:45pm PT. If ops accepts temporary managed-KMS concession, I can expedite.
Tess (Legal): ACK. I'll include an attestation checklist and sample clause for key custody.
Abe (AE): Scheduling a 20-min exec sync at 3pm PT. Please keep thread updates here only. If we get a temp managed-KMS promise with a swap date, this stays green. :lock:
